title: NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own): Return of the Current Term's Risk Premium on Cancellation
content:
Refund schedule entry for the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own): how much of the current term's risk premium — the risk premium charges booked for the current term apart from those of the policy's latest premium-bearing endorsement — a cancellation returns.

**Rule.** The current term's risk premium a cancellation returns is settled as follows: when the cancellation effective date falls before the current term start, it is returned in full; when the cancellation effective date falls on or after the current term start, the reason is one of those that bar a refund once a claim has been paid, and a loss dated on or after the current term start carries claim payments, net of the payment items voided, above zero, where the records place that loss, or the records cannot place a paid loss on either side of the current term start and the current term's return is held, nothing is returned; otherwise it is returned for the days from the cancellation effective date to the term end over the days of the current term.

**Terms.** The reasons that bar a refund once a claim has been paid are mortgage paid off, voluntary — not required, replaced by private flood, and removed from the Special Flood Hazard Area by a Letter of Map Amendment or Revision. The current term's return is held where the records cannot place such a paid loss on either side of the current term start, that is when no loss dated after the month band around the current term start carries such payments, a loss dated in that band does, and the latest loss on which a claim payment was ever issued is dated after the band, or is dated in the band on or after the current term start with its payments all voided; the month band is the losses dated as many whole calendar months before the processing date as the current term start is.

## Schedule

| Cancellation effective date | Reason bars a refund once a claim is paid | Paid loss on or after the current term start, or return held | Current term's risk premium returned |
|---|---|---|---|
| before the current term start | any | any | in full |
| on or after the current term start | yes | yes | nothing |
| on or after the current term start | yes | no | days from the effective date to the term end, over the days of the current term |
| on or after the current term start | no | any | days from the effective date to the term end, over the days of the current term |

## Cases (hypothetical; 365-day term, current term risk premium 2,920.00)

- Building sold, effective 73 days before the term end: 2,920.00 times 73 over 365 is 584.00.
- Mortgage paid off, effective 73 days before the term end, a loss dated after the term start with 5,000.00 paid net: nothing.
- Building sold with the title transfer date before the current term start: 2,920.00 in full.
